title: Agent Lifecycle Measurement Contract Register Response
description: ALR-1106 Route 2 response (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:598-612): the 201 first-registration or 200 exact-key-replay response for POST /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/agent-lifecycle/measurement-contracts. Closed with exactly nine properties -- no source id, item key, raw digest, evaluator instruction/configuration, membership list, or private provenance (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:598). `expected_count` is computed exclusively by Backend from the accepted immutable membership captured in the same transaction, never from a client-supplied value (there is no such field anywhere in the request); it is bounded to the beta ceiling [1,10000] (corpus case measurement_contract_register_zero_universe proves the response-only minimum:1 floor -- Route 2's request has no count field at all, so a zero-item registration is decidable only against this response schema, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1046). `universe_trust_level`/`evaluator_trust_level` are Claim-ceiling composition facts (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:198): a client_attested source can support protocol completeness but never raises comparability, Qualification, Standing, or authority -- this response has no field through which a client-supplied universe could ever claim a stronger trust level than what Backend actually accepted. `TypedOpaqueRef` lives in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json; this document $refs it cross-file rather than duplicating the shape. Every property below carries its own x-disclosure annotation at its own JSON Pointer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:406-409, :432-439).

expected_count.description: Computed exclusively from the accepted immutable membership (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:607); >=1 and <=10000 (beta ceiling). A registration resolving to zero or more than 10000 items is rejected before mint (service_invalid, corpus cases measurement_contract_register_zero_universe [response-only, schema-decidable minimum:1] and measurement_contract_register_backend_membership_exceeds_beta_ceiling [service-decidable]).

universe_trust_level.description: The least of DatasetVersion and SliceDefinitionVersion trust (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:608); composition fact only, never a completeness/comparability claim (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:198).

evaluator_trust_level.description: The evaluator source's own trust, reported separately from universe_trust_level because it governs a different axis (measurement method, not measurement population) (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:609).
